criteria.no_way_around: The cheap fix the last audit named is in. checks.ford_leg memoizes each ford's nearest brook segment, and settle_field fell, e.g. 40/39 1.57 -> 1.11 s and 10/39 0.92 -> 0.52 s. The other option, keeping the reservation, is slower: the main leg is faster without it, so the GM's only-if-significantly-faster test is not met. Left over, profiled at 40/39: ford_crossing's linear any() over brook legs, 601k segments_cross, about a quarter of settle_field. Bucketing the brook by cell would trim it by roughly 0.3 s wall on the worst seed; recommended, not blocking. Also pre-existing and outside this feature: the notice siting's 18k-probe mode.
